issues.problem: The monitors face south while the chairs serving their desks are on the north side. Seated users see the backs of the monitors.
issues.fix: Rotate these monitors 180 degrees so their screens face north toward the seated users.

issues.problem: The task chairs are roughly 0.7–0.8 m from the nearest desk edges, too far away for normal desk work. Each row also puts three chairs across a desk only 1.10–1.66 m wide, leaving the outer chairs largely beside the work surface rather than in usable working positions.
issues.fix: Bring chairs within working reach of the desks and distribute them around usable sides, facing the work surfaces. Do not retain three side-by-side workstations on these short desks.

issues.problem: The collaboration stools sit too far from the oval table to use it comfortably, and the outer stools extend beyond its ends. The stools are also backed up close to the window wall.
issues.fix: Redistribute the stools around the table's available sides and bring them closer, leaving enough room to sit down and get up.

issues.problem: Both whiteboard panels overlap windows rather than clear wall areas, obstructing use of the windows.
issues.fix: Move the panels onto solid wall sections with clear access for viewing and writing.

fixes.reason: reviewer preferred the change in both orders
